text:
Maya Torres: Heads up — I9m due mid-September and planning to take parental leave starting Sept 10 for 12 weeks. I9m also on a short-term visa and hope to fly home for 4 of those weeks to get family help. What steps do I need to take so payroll, benefits, and visa are OK?

Sam (People Ops): Congrats Maya! Quick checklist: 1) File parental leave in HR portal with exact dates and indicate international travel during leave. 2) Upload physician note and travel plan. 3) Tick the supplemental pay/top-up election if you want Redwood top-up applied while abroad.

Maya Torres: If I elect top-up, will taxes change because I9m abroad for part of it?

Payroll-Bot: Top-up payroll note: Redwood processes top-up on US payroll. Short international travel can change tax residency if you exceed local thresholds — payroll will run a withholding estimate. Link: https://handbook.internal/payroll/travel

Payroll-Bot: Please confirm whether you want top-up (yes/no) so we can run estimate.

Maya Torres: Yes please run estimate.

Michelle (People Ops): Immigration note: mark the HR form so we trigger immigration counsel review. If international travel overlaps with any visa stamping or reciprocity windows we may advise adjusting dates. Also we can annotate performance cycle to be leave-exempt.

Maya Torres: Thanks. Also worried about coverage: my manager suggested a 6-week contractor and redistribution of two projects. Who approves hiring and budget?

Sam (People Ops): Use the emergency backfill pool funding form (Handbook > Leaves > Backfill). If you paste a 1-paragraph rationale here I can pre-approve manager review and fast-track approvals.

Maya Torres: Draft rationale: "Maya Torres (ENG) will be on parental leave 9/10-12/2 with 4 weeks abroad. Request a 6-week backend contractor (Aug 29 - Oct 10) to preserve oncall coverage and critical bug triage. Estimated cost $12k."

Sam (People Ops): Pre-approved for manager review. Submit the funding form and ping me.

IT-Support: On device custody: If you9re traveling abroad for medical/family reasons, we can approve short-term device retention. Submit IT retention form and we9ll apply MDM location restrictions + remote wipe.

Maya Torres: Will do. One final: can my manager mark my mid-cycle review as deferred? I9m concerned about goal weighting.

Michelle (People Ops): Yes — mark review as "deferred due to approved parental leave" in the review form. HR will annotate calibration so compensation/promotions are not negatively impacted.

Maya Torres: Thank you all — I9ll file the HR form today and paste the funding request link when submitted.
